summary:
SL-102 changes tests only, and it now pins both M6 gates. `src` is byte-identical to b719e31 (git diff b719e31 HEAD -- src is empty).

What I ran on this PC at HEAD a8fa4cf:
- The SL-102 repro exits 0.
- The default suite passes 874/874. StalledShareTests executed 0 times, the 3 Theory rows and both admin-share Facts passed, and OptInTraitTests passed.
- Fitness: all 91 rules hold.
- The committed driver `Mutants.ps1` (all mutants, both TEMPs) exits 0, and each mutant was killed by exactly the tests it should be:
  - unmutated: 874/874 under both C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp;
  - mutant A: exactly the 3 Theory rows went red;
  - mutant B: exactly the two admin-share Facts went red;
  - each single-bit drop: only that bit's row went red;
  - every run executed 874 tests, and every DLL was written after its edit.
- Worktree afterwards: Scanner.cs hash unchanged (04CD40F9…), `git diff --exit-code src tests` = 0, no fsa-sl102-mutants-* copy left, and no testhost, MSBuild or VBCSCompiler process left running.

Real contact:
1. A read-only probe of this PC's own admin share. \\localhost\C$ and \\127.0.0.1\C$ both answer, report fs=NTFS, and FileRemoteProtocolInfo succeeds on them (protocol 0x00020000). A local handle gets error 87. This is O-013's precondition, so the mutant-B kill is not vacuous here.
2. The opt-in SMB-LOOPBACK test, run from this tree's own code in a Windows Sandbox (26100.9457) as a local user `fsauser` through a scheduled task, with a real New-SmbMapping on 127.0.0.1:
   - unmutated: passed in 1 m 14 s;
   - mutant B: failed in 1 m 09 s at StalledShareTests.cs:114, the new assert: `Expected: Tuple (0, 0) Actual: Tuple (3, 3)`. The DLL was written after the edit.
   - no mapping remained after either run.

   Until now that assert had never run in this tree.

A scratch probe also checked design case 12, which the build filed: a scan root that itself carries OFFLINE, PINNED or UNPINNED is left out of the ask. It measured asked 3 against 4 for a plain root, with bytes still 3.

Not checked:
- Cases 5 (the recall bits) and 11 (an admin share that does not answer). The design marked both non-material and filed them. Neither can be produced on this PC without a cloud sync engine or a change to the machine's sharing settings.
- Windows 10.

There is no loop: one build attempt. Validate attempt 1 was turned away by the provider and never ran.

criteria.criterion: 1. Leave a cloud-marked folder out of the last-access ask when the subfolder carries OFFLINE (0x1000), set by TempTree.AddAttributes
criteria.how: Theory row `attribute: Offline` (LastAccessTests.cs) asserts the listing precondition, Completed, Bytes 4 and Asked 3. It passed in the default suite and in both driver baselines. Mutant A and the Offline bit-drop each turn that row red under both TEMPs.

criteria.criterion: 2. Same, when the subfolder carries PINNED (0x80000)
criteria.how: Row `attribute: 524288` passes unmutated under both TEMPs. Mutant A and the Pinned bit-drop turn it red, and only it.

criteria.criterion: 3. Same, when the subfolder carries UNPINNED (0x100000)
criteria.how: Row `attribute: 1048576` passes unmutated under both TEMPs. Mutant A and the Unpinned bit-drop turn it red, and only it.

criteria.criterion: 4. Still count what is under a cloud-marked folder (plain subfolder and files)
criteria.how: Each row asserts Bytes 4, so off\one.txt and off\inner\two.txt are counted, and Asked 3 (root, a, off\inner). Under mutant A the failure is Asked 4, which shows off\inner was still asked. Known limit, waived to SC-298: a gate shifted one level also reads 3.

criteria.criterion: 5. Leave a cloud-marked folder out when it carries RECALL_ON_OPEN or RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS
criteria.how: The design marked this non-material and filed it. User mode cannot set these bits on a folder (SC-290..292), and the CF-SYNC-ROOT rig was not run. The scanner's mask includes both bits (Scanner.cs:143), but nothing here exercised them.

criteria.criterion: 6. Catch a cloud bit dropped from the mask (Scanner.cs:143-144)
criteria.how: Mutants.ps1 Offline, Pinned and Unpinned mutants: under both TEMPs only the dropped bit's row went red, with 874 executed each time. Dropping a recall bit survives by design (see 5).

criteria.criterion: 7. Turn the default suite red when the attribute gate is removed (mutant A)
criteria.how: Mutants.ps1 mutant A: 3 failed under each TEMP, exactly the 3 Theory rows. The DLL was newer than the edit and 874 tests executed.

criteria.criterion: 8. Ask nothing of a share's folders through \\localhost\C$ and \\127.0.0.1\C$ from above the store (`above`)
criteria.how: The (Asked, Kept) == (0, 0) assert on `above` passes in the default suite. The share branch is really taken here: the probe shows Directory.Exists True on both hosts, and mutant B turns the Fact red under both TEMPs. The dedicated LastAccessTests admin-share Fact asserts the same and is also killed by B.

criteria.criterion: 9. Ask nothing of a share's folders through a link into the tree (`throughLink`)
criteria.how: The (0, 0) assert on `throughLink` passes under both TEMPs. Under B the Fact stops at the `above` assert first. That the throughLink assert bites on its own (asked 3) comes from the risk spike's run; I did not re-measure it.

criteria.criterion: 10. Turn the default suite red when the remote gate is removed (mutant B)
criteria.how: Mutants.ps1 mutant B: under each TEMP, exactly ContainerLayerStoreTests.AScanThroughThisPcsAdminShare... and LastAccessTests.NothingOnThisPcsAdminShare... went red, with 874 executed.

criteria.criterion: 11. Ask nothing of a share's folders when this PC's admin share does not answer
criteria.how: The design marked this non-material and filed it. On this PC the admin share answers on both hosts, so the `continue` branch is never taken here. Producing the other state needs a sharing change or another account. Not measured, and not measured on Windows 10 either.

criteria.criterion: 12. Leave a cloud-marked folder out when the scan root itself carries a cloud attribute (ListRoot caller)
criteria.how: Behaviour measured with a scratch probe (.taad-scratch/validate/rootprobe). A plain root gives asked 4. A root with OFFLINE, PINNED or UNPINNED gives asked 3 each, still Completed with bytes 3. No committed test pins this case (filed by build); the behaviour holds.

criteria.criterion: 13. Keep the opt-in share test opt-in when the new asserts go into StalledShareTests
criteria.how: Default-suite TRX: 0 StalledShareTests results among 874 executed, and OptInTraitTests (10 rows plus EveryOptInTraitIsExcludedByTheDefaultFilter) passed. The diff adds no Trait or Skip, only the assert and remarks.

criteria.criterion: 14. Accept the slice: the repro's regex reader meets a [Theory] with [InlineData] rows and asserts inside an existing share Fact
criteria.how: The SL-102 repro exits 0 with 1/1 passed. The repro file is unchanged since the repro stage, so none of this slice's commits touched it.

criteria.criterion: (person-run at opening) (b) A LastAccessAsked == 0 assertion on a scan of the opt-in SMB-LOOPBACK share
criteria.how: StalledShareTests.cs:114 asserts (Asked, Kept) == (0, 0). I ran it from this tree's code in a Windows Sandbox as local user fsauser, with a real New-SmbMapping on 127.0.0.1. Unmutated it passed (1:14). Under mutant B it failed at line 114 with Actual (3, 3). No mapping was left afterwards. Still not run on this PC (26200) under the person's own logon; that run stays the filed check by hand.

obligations.evidence: On this PC both conditions hold. The read-only probe shows \\localhost\C$ and \\127.0.0.1\C$ each give Directory.Exists=True, report fs=NTFS, and answer FileRemoteProtocolInfo successfully (protocol 0x00020000); a local handle gets error 87. Mutant B turning both admin-share Facts red under both TEMPs (Mutants.ps1, exit 0) shows the guarded branch is reached rather than skipped. Holds on this PC only. Windows 10 and a PC with admin shares off are not measured (Q-224); there the kill would go vacuous.

not_reached: The SMB-LOOPBACK test on this PC (Windows 11 26200) under the person's own logon. I ran it only in Windows Sandbox 26100.9457 as a local Administrators user via a scheduled task (batch logon). The person's filed check stays: run `eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx --filter "Network=SMB-LOOPBACK&FullyQualifiedName~StalledShareTests"` once; it must pass, and no \\127.0.0.1\fsa<8hex> mapping may remain.
Windows 10, and any PC or account where \\localhost\C$ does not answer. There both admin-share Facts `continue` silently, and mutant B would survive the default suite (Q-224, case 11).
Folders with RECALL_ON_OPEN or RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS. User mode cannot set them, and the CF-SYNC-ROOT rig was not run.
A non-Windows SMB server, such as a NAS running Samba that reports NTFS. Only this PC's own LanmanServer and the SMBLibrary rig were reached.
That the throughLink assert bites on its own under mutant B. In my runs the Fact stops at the `above` assert first; only the risk spike measured throughLink alone (asked 3).
The scan-root (ListRoot) case is confirmed only by a scratch probe. No committed test pins it, so a regression there would not turn the suite red (filed by build).
